name: @aparte/engine
//: core depends on engine (D1); engine keeps core only as a devDependency, for its parity tests. nx reads devDependencies as graph edges too, which made engine:build → core:gen → engine:build a cycle. Engine's build needs nothing from core — its sources import none of it — so the edge is removed here; the tests resolve core through the workspace link and the source condition, not through a build order.

typecheck.//: Explicit, so the @nx/js/typescript plugin's inferred one (tsc --build --emitDeclarationOnly, outputs: dist) is not used: that one emits into the dist that build owns and declares it as an output, and a cache hit on it restored a declaration-only snapshot over the full dist. A typecheck writes nothing and claims nothing.
